messages:
anya: heads-up i'm experimenting with a 'size-aware' routing flag for embeddings. goal: reduce 413s + OOMs by routing suspect payloads to a conservative pool. want thoughts on signals + how we show it in the console.

devon: what qualifies as 'suspect'? missing dims? huge byte arrays? mixed dims?

anya: all of the above. short list of signals: missing-dims, mixed-dims, >1MB payload, vector_count>1024. each increments a risk score.

ravi: risk scoring makes sense. weight missing-dims high since clients often forget it. maybe also weight per-tenant historical error-rate.

mika: console needs to show "risk distribution" per route and a toggle to force-route high-risk traffic to slowpath. PMs will want an estimate of cost delta if they move x% to slowpath.

devon: from runtime POV, implement opt-in header first: `X-Embed-Risk: low|med|high`. if present, we respect. if absent, runtime computes and emits `embed_risk` tag in telemetry.

anya: good. and fallback logic: if classification uncertain, prefer slowpath (safer). we should also expose a fast-fail client error telling them to add the header when we see repeated misclassifications.

opex-bot: [metric] embed_request_errors increased by 2.1% in eu-central at 2026-03-02T14:22:10Z

ravi: that alert is probably related to yesterday's SDK release that removed automatic dims header for batch clients. we need an SDK helper: `embed.computeRisk(payload)` across python/node.

mika: dashboard idea: for each route show p50/p95 latency for low/med/high buckets, plus per-1k-token cost estimate. add a small sparkline showing the last 7d shift in risk mix.

devon: telemetry bits: `embed_risk`, `risk_reason` (list of tags: missing-dims,mixed-dims,oversize), `route_effective_pool`. also record `fallback_reason` when runtime demotes to slowpath.

anya: quotas: if we route more to slowpath, capacity needs to be visible in console. propose a new column 'slowpath headroom' with capacity% and projected saturation at current growth.

ravi: can we implement a soft throttle on borderline high-risk to shed to slowpath and emit 429 with `Retry-After`? avoids OOMs but keeps caller aware.

devon: runtime can do that: soft-shed when slowpath headroom < 15%. return 429 + header `X-Embed-Shed-Reason: slowpath_capacity`. telemetry will mark as shed_event.

mika: UX note: show recent shed events per tenant in the console and provide a 'request reroute' button for SRE to temporarily divert a tenant's traffic to dedicated throughput pool.

anya: rollout plan: 1) add header + sdk helper, 2) add telemetry tags, 3) console risk panel (beta toggle), 4) runtime default heuristic and soft-shed, 5) 2-week canary with 10% traffic.

ravi: add an experiment flag to flip classification threshold per-tenant so we can A/B the cost+error impact.

devon: logging: on any fallback/soft-shed, log once per request with `reason`, `computed_risk`, `header_present`. avoid high-cardinality payload hashes.

opex-bot: [note] create incident-runbook stub for embed_shedding in incidents channel

mika: i'll sketch console mocks tomorrow and attach to the PR.

anya: thanks all. i'll draft the API docs for `X-Embed-Risk` and the sdk helpers. keeping default conservative. :thumbsup:

(ravi added reaction :rocket:)
